name: HPRR Shielding Benchmark
description: A compiled evaluation dataset and protocols for validating shielding experiment results from the HPRR experiments to produce a published shielding benchmark.
evaluation_method: error metrics (RMSE / MAE) comparing predicted vs. experimental shielding results
reputation: A niche, domain-specific benchmark used primarily within radiation shielding and nuclear engineering research for validating simulation and experimental results.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark based on experimental shielding data; relatively small and domain-specific dataset with potential variability due to experimental conditions—care required when generalizing results.
